title: 2023 HMMT November Guts Problem 15
statement: Lucas writes two distinct positive integers on a whiteboard. He decreases the smaller number by 20 and increases the larger number by 23 , only to discover the product of the two original numbers is equal to the product of the two altered numbers. Compute the minimum possible sum of the original two numbers on the board.

solutions.text:
Let the original numbers be \(m<n\). We know

\[m n=(m-20)(n+23)=m n-20 n+23 m-460 \Longrightarrow 23 m-20 n=460\]

Furthermore, \(23 m<23 n\) hence \(460<3 n \Longrightarrow n \geq 154\). Furthermore, we must have \(23 \mid n\) hence the least possible value of \(n\) is 161 which corresponds \(m=160\).
This yields a minimum sum of \(161+160=321\).
